notes.title: After Us v1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315112/e02e4af970f4ff7127cf2ef9ba0f4b393142e685.png[/img]
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Made general improvements to performance and frame rate.
[*]Improved memory usage during shader precompile.
[*]Added save state backups.
[*]Fixed bug causing some achievements to not be shown or awarded, including Humankind and Perfect Memory.
[*]Adjusted font sizes on Steam Deck.
[*]Hardcoded quality and stability settings on Steam Deck.
[/list]We're still working on getting [b]After Us[/b] Steam Deck verified. Please stay tuned for any updates! If you're encountering an issue that is not listed above, please [b][url=https://support.privatedivision.com/hc/requests/new]contact our support team directly for help[/url][/b].
